note: Generated release 0 of the Tribes of Behavior atlas (ADR-0003 §10). Hand-authored before the database existed; import_atlas loads it as release 0, after which the database is the truth and export_atlas regenerates these files. Do not hand-edit after import.

functions.spec: Linear in t between consecutive keyframes for lon, lat, reach_km and strength (default 1). A colony does not exist before its first or after its last keyframe.
presence = Σ_colonies strength·(1−(d/r)²)² for d < r, else 0; d is great-circle distance on a sphere of radius R_km.
Draw a tribe where its reconciled presence ≥ thresholds[0] (edge) and its core where ≥ thresholds[1].
Walk a [w,s,e,n] box clockwise along meridians and parallels in step_deg steps; e < w crosses the antimeridian; cap 'south' is the ring at latitude n.
Rasterise land at res_deg; count, per cell, the land geos (realm ≠ Seas & Corridors) whose box contains the cell centre; weight by cos(lat); ignore lat < −60.

Within an account, colonies add (kernel). Among accounts mentioning tribe T whose geo contains the point, the smallest-area geo's value stands, including zero. If none contains it, the strongest account wins. Contours after reconciling.
Word → number for models only; the word is what is stored.
Piecewise-linear map from year to slider position, giving the crowded modern centuries room.
